title: Customers received counterfeit or poor quality items
situation: SAR 872 at risk across 8 customers including 1 VIP, requiring immediate refunds and a catalog review.

actions.why: Refund affected customers for the misdescribed items.

actions.reply_en: We are sorry you received an item that is not as described. We have issued a full refund of 109 SAR to your account.
actions.reply_ar: نعتذر لأن المنتج وصلكم بشكل مختلف عن الوصف. لقد قمنا بإصدار استرداد كامل بقيمة 109 ريال لحسابكم.
actions.why: Notify customers of the refund and acknowledge the issue.

params.note: Investigate batch of misdescribed items causing negative customer feedback.

actions.why: Flag the incorrect product listings and quality issue for the catalog team.
